notes: Shot lines require recorded bullet-impact endpoints. Shots without impacts show only a firing flash; aim angles are never rendered as bullet paths.
Health and held weapons update at saved snapshots/events; positions interpolate at 16 Hz.
Fire uses recorded patch centers and burning flags. Nearby centers are joined into one footprint; its interpolated edge is artwork, not engine collision geometry.
Ground loot uses recorded entity positions and ownership transitions.
Smoke uses decoded network voxel masks with enclosed-interior fill. Grid placement is reverse engineered; engine visual parity is unverified.
HE holes are not fabricated for decoded smoke. Visible HE clearing has not been reproduced in the tested round.

This single-round preview uses the newly supplied test_demo.dem, matched by SHA-256 to the existing analysis. Audited impact channels returned no events; firing-message angles/seed/spread are preserved in the original analysis. No substitute hit links or direction rays have been added.
